PHASE.NAME: RTK First-Class Proxy Shortcut Expansion
PHASE.GOAL: Add low-risk first-class Synapse shortcuts for RTK command families that can safely delegate to syn proxy without bespoke parsers.

STEPS.step-1: Add CLI schemas for common RTK proxy shortcuts such as gh, glab, aws, psql, curl, wget, jq, go, golangci, dotnet, rake, rspec, rubocop, gradle, make, just, helm, and kubectl.
STEPS.step-2: Dispatch new shortcuts through the existing RtkProxyCmd::run_as path.
STEPS.step-3: Extend rewrite token-safe detection and tests for the expanded shortcut surface.
